limitations: All cohorts are historically exposed development. HC32/Vid32 are parent-isolated from HC64, not pristine confirmatory test.
Query-level bootstrap; within-query frames are not independent observations. Minimum two near and two far nodes; eligible count changes by metric.
Spatial evidence and observation timing inherit model decisions. Residualization is a nuisance control, not a causal adjustment or predictor.
Native temporal attention uses target-conditioned fused visual/text memory; correlations do not establish the incremental effect of the added spatial branch.
Soft ROI uses full-timeline auxiliary BoxFixed trajectory with no GT event support. Fixed cyclic spatial displacement preserves area; it is not a verified wrong identity.
Higher target attention or consistency does not establish event semantics or target identity. Event annotation has no complete outside-event identity ground truth.
No method/readout fitted, no threshold selected, no new temporal prediction or vIoU claim. Secondary layers and signs are exploratory; no best layer selected.
